adelheid.title: Poison Taster
adelheid.text: Adelheid insists on tasting all of your food for poison. Every meal, spoon first, her steel-blue eyes narrowed and the scar through her eyebrow pulled tight with solemnity. Soup, bread, a suspicious pear. She eventually admits, stiffly, over the last bite of your dinner, that she has started looking forward to dinner time.

choices.label: Ask her to stay for the whole meal
choices.res: She sits across from you in her armor, straight-backed, and eats a whole meal as a guest instead of a guard for the first time. She is very bad at it.

choices.label: Tell her she's allowed to finish the pear
choices.res: "Strictly for safety," you say, handing her the pear. {N} accepts it as a sacred duty, and eats it in tiny, reverent bites.

image.comp: in armor tasting food from his plate with great seriousness, napkin tucked in
image.setting: inn dining room at dinner time

adelheid.title: Rain Barrel
adelheid.text: You cut through the training yard and finds Adelheid washing off after practice at the rain barrel, cold water streaming down her scarred shoulders, her short platinum hair plastered flat. She snaps to attention. With the hand holding the towel. Which is, therefore, no longer holding the towel, quite as well as it should.

choices.label: Turn around immediately
choices.res: "Thank you, my lord," she says, in a very small voice, after the footsteps retreat. She holds the towel with both hands for the rest of the day.

choices.label: Salute back
choices.res: She laughs: a real, startled laugh, the first you've ever heard from her, rough and surprised, like a door that hasn't been opened in years.

choices.label: Stammer helplessly
choices.res: They stand there stammering at each other until a goose interrupts, honking, and the knight loses her last thread of dignity.

image.comp: snapping to attention beside a rain barrel, soaking wet, covering herself with one arm and saluting with the other
image.setting: training yard behind an inn, afternoon

adelheid.title: Knight and Her Lord
adelheid.text: You find Adelheid's secret stash of romance novels in her saddlebag, cracked spines, pressed flowers, a ribbon marking every chapter. Every one is about a knight and her lord. She threatens you with her sword, steel flashing, face scarlet to the roots of her hair. Then asks, very quietly, if you've read the third one.

choices.label: Ask which part of the third one is her favorite
choices.res: She tells you, with the sword still half-drawn and her eyes fixed on a point past your shoulder. It is the chapter in the rain. You take detailed notes, as is tradition.

choices.label: Hand the books back and promise silence
choices.res: You swear silence on your honor, which causes her to blush deeper. {N} sheathes the sword with great ceremony, and asks if you want to borrow volume two.

image.comp: pointing a sword at him while clutching a stack of romance novels to her chest, scarlet

adelheid.title: The Report
adelheid.text: The Order demands Adelheid report on "the sinful nature" of your business. She's been staring at a blank page for three hours, a candle burned to a stub beside her, the quill chewed ragged. Her oath and her honesty are pulling in opposite directions, and the sound of her sword-hilt tapping the desk fills the room.

choices.label: "Tell them the truth."
choices.res: She writes three pages: fair wages, rest days, no one here against her will. She reads them twice and seals them with pride, the wax pressed hard.

choices.label: "Could you... leave some things out?"
choices.res: Her face goes hard. "I will not lie, my lord. Not even for you." It's a long, cold week, and she guards your door like a stranger.

choices.label: Go to the Order with her
choices.res: You answer their questions yourself, politely, for four hours. Adelheid stands beside you the entire time, shoulders squared, not once looking away.

image.comp: sitting at a desk staring at a blank page, quill frozen, troubled expression

adelheid.title: Swordplay
adelheid.text: Adelheid decides you must be able to defend yourself, and hands you a practice sword in the cold dawn of the training yard. It's much heavier than it looks. Her stance is flawless, her voice crisp: "Feet apart, my lord. Grip firm. Again." Your wrists are already complaining, and a rooster is laughing at you.

choices.label: Practice until you drop
choices.res: You drop. Twice. She is quietly, enormously proud, and her hand lingers on your shoulder as she helps you up.

choices.label: Let her win on purpose
choices.res: She knows. She hates that. Her scar-split brow lowers dangerously. "Again, and properly this time."

adelheid.title: The Amended Oath
adelheid.text: Adelheid kneels in the empty chapel hall to renew her oath, the candlelight turning her short hair to silver, then stays kneeling. "My oath was to serve you. I would like to amend it." Her voice is steady but her hand, when she takes yours, trembles. "To stand beside you." She rises, and doesn't let go.

choices.label: Not yet
choices.res: {N} bows her head, stiff with discipline. "I can wait. Don't make it too long." She resumes her post by your door, and stands one pace closer.
